office.en: Governor of California, November 3, 2026 general election. Republican. Certified candidate list, August 27, 2026.

sourceTitle.en: Steve Hilton for Governor 2026, “No State Income Tax on Your First $150,000,” retrieved September 29, 2026. The page does not show a publication date.

summary.en: His campaign pages propose no California income tax on the first $150,000, more in-state oil production with the Low Carbon Fuel Standard suspended, education savings accounts starting with some students, and a smaller general fund tied to that tax cut.

whyIncluded.en: The other candidate for governor on the certified November 2026 ballot. Tax, oil, school, and budget lines are taken from his campaign policy pages.
